brief:
Denmark announced $8.9 million in humanitarian assistance for Palestinians, according to Middle East Eye, with an emergency allocation designated to help people affected by severe winter flooding in Gaza.

The pledge comes as Gaza faces winter weather conditions that have exacerbated the humanitarian situation in the territory. The aid package includes both immediate relief for flood victims and broader humanitarian support for the Palestinian population.
dek: Denmark pledges $8.9m in aid for Gaza amid severe winter flooding Denmark has announced $8.9m in humanitarian aid for Palestinians, including an emergency allocation to help people affected by flooding in Gaza.
title: Denmark pledges $8.9m in humanitarian aid for flood-hit Gaza
